disclaimer: DISCLAIMER — Granger 'causality' is a test of whether lagged values of X improve the prediction of Y beyond Y's own lags. It is NOT proof of physical or structural causation. A common hidden factor (e.g. a geopolitical shock) can move fleet activity and prices together. Report results as: 'X statistically predicts Y at lag N days (adjusted p < α)', never 'X causes Y'.
